subject: alt-d
title: (R)ALT.D.------AFI.
description: Diagram in WAM-22, on the page following Braxton's argument that notation in western art music produced 'the gradual inability of western musicians to function creatively without notation'. The subject (R)ALT-D — the reality of alternative definitions — is crossed with AFI (affinity insight); the (c) prefix on AFI reads "the concept of", while (p) on IST-F marks the *point of idea completion* (per Braxton's CODE notation, p. 12). The main line runs from ALT-D to AFI, and from AFI the path bends on to ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism), which carries ATTN (attraction); ATTN branches into INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), into INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis), which dashed-links to RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits), and, by a *dashed* line, into (p)IST-F (isolated focus). The argument: under western composer-medium conditions, alternative definitions reach reality only through affinity-insight, and from there through alternative composite progressionalism into attraction, which fans out into individual tendencies, information affinity basis and isolated focus.
